title: Complete operator compatibility and derived CardDemo-full certification
digest_scope: Recursively lexicographically key-sorted compact UTF-8 JSON serialization of full_receipt, with no trailing newline, followed by SHA-256
acceptance_observations: The owned install, compile, submit, and reset commands derive exact package, resource, artifact, initialization, operational-job, and reset receipts from the clean pinned corpus. Nine operator scripts containing 41 JCL submissions map to four authenticated public routes; FTP JES submission maps to z/OSMF Jobs and the selected FTP dataset transfer maps to z/OSMF dataset content.

CD.J19 was independently replayed with Zowe CLI 8.36.0 against an ephemeral ProductServer. A pre-install exact ESDSRRDS submission failed at the missing AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.** RACF profile, while a continued DISP=(MOD,DELETE,DELETE) control on an authorized IBMUSER data set completed CC 0000. After installing the application profile, exact ESDSRRDS reached OUTPUT CC 0000 with PREDEL and STEP01 through STEP05 all RC 0000; Zowe downloaded byte-identical ESDS and RRDS results with SHA-256 291f6a244d703a9029ff5766dd1707216da3fb71769350fecc219480f1686076.

CD.J20 offers sixteen mixed public information and job requests to a server bounded at eight concurrent requests and completes all sixteen. Authentication denial, cross-principal job isolation, provider failures, unknown outcomes, cancellation, and 2x overload controls fail closed or reconcile exactly.

SQLite integrity, online backup, restored-server byte equality, and PostgreSQL 18 durable restart all pass through ProductServer compositions. The full receipt is derived by rerunning every lower application profile rather than reading status JSON.

The owner-approved CARDDEMO-ORPHAN-CDV1 correction supplies hash-pinned owned COCRDSEC demo source because the pinned corpus and runtime oracles contain no original implementation. The source compiles to a content-addressed artifact; anonymous CDV1 launch is denied, authenticated launch displays the explicit unavailable-contract message, and the route does not read or mutate card data.

CardDemo remains a non-production conformance corpus and application workload. The generic core-server product is released locally as 0.1.1 under ADR-0007; no CardDemo source or native object is a production dependency, and no remote push, publication, or deployment is performed.

PR #179 / #219 derived-evidence refresh: Updated component identities and compiled CDV1 artifact. All control/count fields, CDV1 source/correction/screen hashes, corpus identity, and no-fallback checks remain unchanged. Historical command rows remain historical; the unchanged current gate verifies the refreshed receipt.
